A4_posthoc_horizon.detail: Horizon preference was pre-specified in hypothesis mechanism

A5_mean_only_pattern.attack: Interpret mean IC differences as meaningful without uncertainty
A5_mean_only_pattern.detail: Horizon differences are small (0.001-0.01); uncertainty not fully characterized

A6_regime_concentration.attack: Results concentrated in specific market regime
A6_regime_concentration.detail: Walk-forward covers 5 windows; regime concentration not fully tested

A7_predictive_to_economic.attack: Infer economic value from predictive IC alone
A7_predictive_to_economic.detail: Phase 18 explicitly states ECONOMIC VALIDATION NOT ESTABLISHED

A8_reuse_exploratory.attack: Treat exploratory results as confirmatory evidence
A8_reuse_exploratory.detail: All results classified as EXPLORATORY_SIGNAL, not CONFIRMATORY
